messages:
Maria: FYI got updated lead-time numbers from the vendor for Q1/Q2 provisioning, wanted to share before the planning sync.
Aj: cool — short summary pls. are we still prioritizing H200 for production? :thinking_face:
Maria: short version: H200 lead time 18-22 weeks for new orders, H100 ~10-14 weeks if we take leftover batches, L40S available with 6-8 week lead if we accept region-limited shipments.
Maria: vendor also flagged an APAC shipping bottleneck that could add 2–3 weeks on top of quoted times.
Leo: that APAC delta is concerning — our APAC surge forecast for Nov–Dec looks like +35% GPU-hour demand vs baseline.
Priya: do we have the weekly GPU-hour projection by region for the holiday surge? can we route more to NA/EU temporarily?
Maria: pasted quick numbers from the workbook:
```text
Projected weekly GPU-hours (Nov–Dec):
- NA: 125000
- EU: 48000
- APAC: 42000 (expected +35%)
Total: 215k
``` 
Maria: if APAC takes the hit, fallback routing to EU adds ~30ms median latency for some customers — product asked for <120ms target.
Aj: thoughts on hedging: reserve a mix (50% H200 reserved, 30% L40S reserved for APAC edge, 20% spot H100 bursts)?
ProcurementBot: FYI — current reserved capacity available: H200 (80 units, NA/EU), L40S (30 units, EU only), H100 spot pools variable. Contract window for H200 reservation pricing starts 2026-02-01.
Ken: numbers check — cost delta per GPU-hour (est): H200 = $3.20, H100 = $2.75 (spot burst avg $1.90), L40S = $1.60. These are rough, include power/cooling.
Priya: if we go heavy on reserved H200 we lock cost predictability but increase capital commitment — do we have an ROI calc for heavy quant/embedding workloads?
Maria: quick ROI: assuming 100k reserved H200 hours/month vs spot mix, we save ~22% per token cost but need 9 months to amortize upfront commit vs usage-based. Spreadsheet link: https://go/redwood/sheets/infra-q1-hw (internal)
Leo: alternative: staggered procurement: 50% order now (prioritize APAC-capable L40S for edge), second tranche after confirmation of Q4 usage trends, include vendor SLA for shipment windows.
Aj: we should also update rollout policies — enable auto-fallback to H100-compatible quantized variants when H200 capacity is saturated. Product ok with slight perf variance for non-SLA customers.
Priya: ops question — can we re-balance existing reserved capacity across regions? any legal/networking constraints?
Ken: short answer: some regions require explicit network peering and power approvals; moving physical reserved capacity is non-trivial and costs ~1–2% of purchase to reassign. Logical routing between regions is easier but adds egress costs.
Maria: action items:
- Priya: run a latency impact matrix for routing APAC->EU fallback by EOD Thu
- Aj: draft staggered procurement order and reserve pricing scenarios by Monday
- Ken: update cost model with exact vendor prices and shipping surcharges
- Leo: monitor APAC demand signals (traffic/telemetry) and flag if weekly >45k GPU-hrs
- ProcurementBot: please emit a reminder 2026-02-01 for contract window open
Priya: noted. I'll also sketch a canary plan to route 10% traffic to EU fallback for the first 2 weeks of Nov.
Aj: if vendor can guarantee APAC shorter lead for L40S, that tilts the decision for edge capacity — pinging vendor contact.
Vendor Contact (via DM): tweeting vendor availability — will confirm by EOD tomorrow.
Maria: 👍 thanks everyone. I'll drop the updated booking plan in the spreadsheet and ping infra planning channel once Aj's draft is ready.
